A should review before acceptance.

Tests include native generated mapping, real-file stub sentinel/markers/retry/PSD-unsupported, late appearance, directory/symlink, concurrent same-name unique stages, snapshot-head and ordinary-Save path ordering, explicit fallback/cleanup failure, reused stage rejection, confirmed Replace after external change, typed UI outcomes/status/cancel/intent/drain. Full map/limits/gates: tools/orchestrate/wp/B5-16/SAVE-DESTINATION-SWIFT-HANDOFF.md. A owns compiler with f451870f archive, focused/adjacent/full and real GUI collision+confirmed Replace, sole main merge. Please preserve any compile/runtime failures; this is source handoff, not runtime acceptance.
